content:
ops-lead: Heads up — asia2 GPU fleet showing sustained degraded capacity over the last 8m. API 95th p95 latency spiking, and autoscaler isn't bringing new instances fast enough. Triggering business impact if sustained.

infra-oncall: Seeing OOM/evictions on multiple pods, node pressure at 92%. Pod churn high.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-8343 — asia2 GPU capacity degradation. Severity: P2. Pager rotations engaged. Link: https://pager.example/INC-2026-8343

maria-eng: Is this only asia2? Any cross-region failovers already started?

infra-oncall: Traffic still hitting asia2. Smart-router didn't kick over because some models flagged as "region-fixed" in routing policy. We can flip fallback to eu1 temporarily.

alex-sre: Recommend temporary routing override + reduce batching to avoid KV-cache thrash. Also propose a small paging policy tweak: reduce the escalation window from 15m->7m for this degradation class.

ops-lead: Agreed on routing override. Who will patch the incidentbot routing policy so we don't miss pages?

maria-eng: I can apply a scoped override on the router config. Patch below:

```
# PATCH: routing override for INC-2026-8343
routes.override.region: asia2 -> eu1
routes.override.models: [*] # temporary
routing.reason: "capacity-deg-asia2-2026-03-18"
```

infra-oncall: Applying now. Making sure canary rules preserve latency-sensitive callers to avoid regressions.

incident-bot: pager policy update proposed by alex-sre: "escalation.window=7m for capacity-degradation". Please acknowledge with `ack` to apply.

alex-sre: ack

ops-lead: ack

oncall-rotation: I pushed the router override, verified traffic shifted ~48% to eu1 within 30s, and overall p95 reduced by ~220ms. Evictions down.

infra-oncall: Confirming node pressure falling to 70% on asia2 after autoscaler scaled back. Still seeing a handful of warmup failures for qconfigs — tracking.

maria-eng: Incidentbot/pagerbot change needs to be codified in playbook so next time rotation can self-apply. I can prep a small PR to add a runbook step and a single-click button in the console.

ops-lead: Please do. Also we should revert overrides when capacity stable. Add automated revert in 30m unless renewed.

alex-sre: I'll open a follow-up task: infra/ops#2747 to add timed-revert for routing overrides and a boolean in pager policy for "short-window-capacity-deg".

incident-bot: Note: auto-revert scheduled in 30m at 1778256489 unless renewed.

infra-oncall: Handing off to maria-eng for postmortem and playbook changes. Next oncall: @oncall-rotation, you're aware and in the loop.

oncall-rotation: Got it — monitoring for reverts + will escalate if p95 climbs past threshold again.

ops-lead: Thanks all. Quick retro: need clearer signal to router to avoid model pinned routing, and incidentbot should allow scoped auto-esc. Small wins today but follow-ups required. :thumbsup:

alex-sre: TL;DR action items: 1) PR for incidentbot runbook change (maria-eng), 2) infra task for timed-revert (alex-sre), 3) add model-pin-exception to smart-router (maria-eng+infra).

maria-eng: I'll take 1 & 3, will ping for review.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-8343 status: mitigation in place, monitoring.

ops-lead: Closing thread here, will keep incident open until revert + brief postmortem.
